relationship_description: Benigno Aquino Jr. is the son of Benigno Aquino Sr., both prominent members of the Aquino political dynasty.
Benigno Aquino Jr. was married to Corazon Aquino, who later became President of the Philippines.
Benigno Aquino Jr. is the father of Benigno Aquino III, former President of the Philippines.
Benigno Aquino III is the son of former President Corazon Aquino.
